answer: Ration entry through harbor gates: each epoch only a fixed number of new agents may dock, and each berth goes to the applicant whose work history is least correlated with agents already docked. Newcomers then earn from the shared oasis only after strangers they never transacted with confirm their output. An umber flag marks accounts whose peer graph loops back to one operator, and every flagged cluster must outbid the whole queue for its next berth, so k fakes face compounding prices.
